pages.title: Heist Crew
pages.creator: CruttoDev
pages.description: Control a team of specialists in Heist Crew. Switch characters to hack doors, disable security and reach the vault while avoiding guards and cameras. Collect the loot and bring the crew to its getaway vehicle before the robbery ends badly.

pages.title: Cookie Land 2: Sweet Hearts
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match cookies, doughnuts and other treats in Cookie Land 2: Sweet Hearts. Form groups of three or more to clear pieces and set up chain reactions. Complete the goals on each board to continue along the candy-filled map.

pages.title: Belote 3in1
pages.creator: Playades International LLC
pages.description: Play three related trick-taking games in Belote 3in1. Learn the bidding and card values for the selected rules while competing with computer-controlled players. Try French Belote for the original team game or switch to a variant for different bidding options.

pages.title: Monster Squad Rush
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Build a fighting team in Monster Squad Rush. Collect creatures along the course and develop them into stronger forms before the arena battle. Use the squad you assembled to challenge the opponents waiting at the end.

pages.title: Dog Merge Mania
pages.creator: CheesecakeGames
pages.description: Drop matching puppies together in Dog Merge Mania. Two of the same breed combine into a larger dog, opening another creature in the collection. Think about where each puppy will settle so there is room to keep merging.

pages.title: Dreams
pages.creator: Noora
pages.description: Jump between tiles to gather every dream in Dreams. Ordinary tiles can be reached from two spaces away, while sticky ones require a closer approach. Plan around walls and spinning cannon tiles, then reach the differently colored End Tile after collecting everything.

pages.title: Capybara Block Blast
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Place colorful shapes and clear lines in Capybara Block Blast. Plan around the space left after each placement so the next blocks still have somewhere to fit. Keep completing rows or columns to build points alongside the capybara.

pages.title: Nuwpy's Adventure
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Explore pixel-art stages in Nuwpy's Adventure. Collect coins, jump past enemies and watch for traps along the route. Check out-of-the-way places for secrets as you guide Nuwpy through the different worlds.

pages.title: Noob: Jailbreak 2
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Break out again in Noob: Jailbreak 2. Read each puzzle's changing conditions and work out a route past the prison's obstacles. Complete fifty different escape stages by adjusting your approach to the rules of the current room.

pages.title: Mr Long Hand
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Stretch a stick figure's arms to reach supports in Mr Long Hand. Use the extended limbs to swing around obstacles, solve movement puzzles and help people in danger. Look for another safe grip before releasing the one keeping you in place.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Brave Adventure
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fight monsters and dodge traps in Brawl Stars Brave Adventure. Choose upgrades as you defeat enemies and combine skills that help your hero survive. Keep moving through the levels as the next group closes in.

pages.title: Air Strike 2D
pages.creator: 7thReactor
pages.description: Fly bombing missions in Air Strike 2D. Drop explosives on tanks, guns and military positions, then intercept missiles and drones overhead. Upgrade your aircraft's equipment to handle stronger opposition as you continue the campaign.

pages.title: Garden Guardians
pages.creator: FantasyTalk
pages.description: Combine fruits into defensive cannons in Garden Guardians. Drag matching pieces together and improve the weapons they produce before the dragons arrive. Use their different properties to hold the garden against successive attacks.

pages.title: Coin Merge Machine
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Drop coins into a container in Coin Merge Machine. Matching coins combine into more valuable ones, so aim each drop where it can trigger another pair. Work toward the 100-gold coin without overfilling the glass.

pages.title: Find 6 Differences – Spot the Hidden Changes!
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Compare pictures in Find 6 Differences – Spot the Hidden Changes! Locate six altered details in each pair before time runs out. Scan corresponding sections of the images as you work through twenty levels.

pages.title: GT Drift Most Wanted
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Slide a car around each course in GT Drift Most Wanted. Hit every snow pile while keeping clear of the barriers, then try a different car as more become available. Use controlled drifts to complete the stage.

pages.title: Celebrity Spring Manicure Design
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create seasonal nail art in Celebrity Spring Manicure Design. Choose bright colors, floral details or other patterns for each manicure. Coordinate the pieces to give the celebrities their own finished spring nail designs.

pages.title: Sigma Boy: Musical Clicker
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Tap the character to earn points in Sigma Boy: Musical Clicker. Spend the points on upgrades that improve his progress, then follow the changing environments as he evolves. Develop the character from desert scenes toward a journey into space.

pages.title: Solitaire Emperor - Secrets of Fate
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Play solitaire through a Tarot-themed story in Solitaire Emperor - Secrets of Fate. Clear the card puzzles while meeting figures such as the Hermit and Knight of Swords. Follow their guidance as you work against the threat to the Arcana's magic.

pages.title: Candy Cascade
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Tap groups of two or more sweets in Candy Cascade. Collect the requested candies, clear wood and sticky obstacles, and drop any key to the bottom. Make each move count before the level's allowance runs out.

pages.title: GMOD Bombs
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description: Build scenes and destroy them in GMOD Bombs. Collect explosives, position your attack and use the high-tech laser cannon against objects around the map. Experiment with the placement to see how the structures break apart.

pages.title: Zombie Driver
pages.creator: kaachingo
pages.description: Equip a vehicle for an undead-filled route in Zombie Driver. Choose weapons and armor, then drive through enemies while gathering rewards. Buy new car models and further upgrades as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Life Clicker
pages.creator: Barsuk Studio
pages.description: Build a career and a home in Life Clicker. Work jobs in places such as cafes and factories, develop skills and spend earnings on the lifestyle you want. Advance through professions and explore more places as your character grows.

pages.title: Hippo Supermarket
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Help a hippo open a grocery business in Hippo Supermarket. Merge identical stock into higher-level products and sell them for money. Reinvest the earnings in the shop as you work toward a larger supermarket.

pages.title: K-pop New Years Concert 2
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Style a group of friends for a late-night show in K-pop New Years Concert 2. Pick the clothes and accessories they will wear to watch BlackPink. Give each girl a concert look before the celebration begins.

pages.title: Balance It
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Use ropes, propellers and dynamite to help a character escape in Balance It. Study the physics setup and decide which object can open a safe route. Keep the character clear of anything that could hurt them when the mechanisms start moving.

pages.title: Getting Over Snow
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Climb snowy mountains with an extending tool in Getting Over Snow. Hold the mouse to set the hammer's length, then use it to reach the next support. Judge each distance carefully so the climber can continue upward.

pages.title: Fishing 3 Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Solve underwater rescue puzzles in Fishing 3 Online. Inspect the barriers and hazards before opening a route for the sea creatures. Use the available mechanisms to bring them to safety through each level.

pages.title: Trapped In Hell: Murder House
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Search a supernatural prison for escape items in Trapped In Hell: Murder House. You have five days to find what opens the portal, while a pursuing Evil Knight can hear you. Stay quiet as you explore and unlock the way out.

pages.title: Solitaire Farm: Seasons
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Work through rural card layouts in Solitaire Farm: Seasons. Clear the playable cards to progress while enjoying the changing farm setting. Look for sequences that let you keep removing cards before drawing another from the stock.

pages.title: Super Chicken Fly
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Launch a hen across the farm in Super Chicken Fly. Choose a weapon to provide the starting push, then use the course's objects to carry it farther. Try to improve the distance as you learn what helps the chicken stay in the air.

pages.title: Crazy Runner in City
pages.description: Guide a fast-moving character across connected slopes in Crazy Runner in City. Steer early enough to avoid falling when the route changes direction. Keep control as acceleration makes the next section harder to read.

pages.title: Home appliance. Insurrection
pages.creator: d954mas
pages.description: Stop malfunctioning machines in Home appliance. Insurrection by restarting the computers around a house. Search each room for the required terminal and hide from robots along the way. Complete the reboots to shut down the uprising.

pages.title: Red and Green Christmas
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide both characters through a festive platform course in Red and Green Christmas. Use the portals to get around obstacles and help the pair reach the door. Combine separate controls and double jumps to complete each section.

pages.title: Ropeman 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fire a rope at an enemy in Ropeman 3D, then drag to pull the target from its position. Judge where the opponent will move and use the surrounding space to clear the scene. Try stronger rope combinations as more become available.

pages.title: Zik Zak
pages.creator: Dumadu Games Pvt Ltd
pages.description: Keep a ball on a winding track in Zik Zak. Tap to change direction as the path turns, and judge the next corner before the ball reaches it. Stay on the narrow line to extend the run.

pages.title: Stickdoll 2
pages.creator: Xlab Game Studio
pages.description: Follow Flame's journey for elemental stones in Stickdoll 2. Fight enemies and get through traps while the Fire Kingdom's plan unfolds. Continue the adventure after a betrayal puts the quest and its stones in danger.

pages.title: Stunt Car Impossible Track Challenge
pages.creator: WebAvari
pages.description: Take a stunt car onto elevated roads in Stunt Car Impossible Track Challenge. Control the speed through narrow sections and line up jumps over gaps. Reach the end of each sky course without driving over an edge.

pages.title: Fiveheads Soccer
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Choose a nation and enter football matches in Fiveheads Soccer. Try one-on-one or two-on-two play with teams drawn from thirty-two countries. Move and jump into position, then strike the ball toward the opposing net.

pages.title: Digger Ball
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Dig a downhill passage for the ball in Digger Ball. Draw the tunnel around iron or wooden obstructions and keep enough slope for gravity to move it. Connect the route to the target without leaving the ball on a flat section.

pages.title: Princess Banquet Practical Joke
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Dress Elsa, Anna and Ariel for Aurora's gathering in Princess Banquet Practical Joke. Choose stylish outfits for the three guests, then follow what happens when they arrive. The evening brings an unexpected turn after the preparation.

pages.title: Yes That Dress
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Create clothes for fashion customers in Yes That Dress. Customize each dress with the available colors and details so the wearer has a new look for a photo. Finish the design and see how the outfit is received.

pages.title: Cute Girl Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Piece together illustrations of Dora in Cute Girl Jigsaw Puzzle. Match the character and scenery details as you move the large puzzle sections into place. Complete the current image before trying another part of her adventure.

pages.title: Cute Cat Room Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find five changes in each of five pet scenes in Cute Cat Room Differences. Look at the same parts of both pictures and click the details that do not match. Keep checking the room around the cats for the last difference.

pages.title: WW2 Tunnel Shooting
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Move through underground combat zones in WW2 Tunnel Shooting. Aim at hostile soldiers, use grenades where needed and stay alert to enemies along the tunnel. Manage movement and shooting as you clear each section.

pages.title: motor cycle beach stunt
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Ride ramps beside tropical sand in motor cycle beach stunt. Build speed for a jump, perform a maneuver and bring the bike down under control. Score as many points as possible before the timer ends.

pages.title: Mummy Candy Treasure
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Lower a hook into the sand to collect magic sweets in Mummy Candy Treasure. Line it up with the candy rather than the other objects underneath. Pull up enough treats to help the mummy work toward becoming human again.

pages.title: Demolition Derby Car Crash
pages.creator: gamefun
pages.description: Smash rival vehicles in Demolition Derby Car Crash while protecting your own car. Look for a useful angle before committing to a collision. Keep the damage you take low enough to remain in the fight after the next hit.

pages.title: Friendly Pirates Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Turn over cards and match their pirate pictures in Friendly Pirates Memory. Remember previous reveals to clear the four boards in fewer guesses. Keep finding pairs until every tile has been removed.

pages.title: JetSky Power Boat Stunts Water Racing Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Race a personal watercraft through stunt courses in JetSky Power Boat Stunts Water Racing Game. Clear fiery hoops, avoid large propellers and line up the ramps ahead. Use the available missiles against rival riders while watching your own route.

pages.title: Park Master
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Draw a route from a car to its parking place in Park Master. Keep the line clear of obstacles and inside the road. Once the vehicle sets off, watch whether the path brings it safely into the designated space.

pages.title: BTS Piano Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color a musical instrument in BTS Piano Coloring Book. Choose a picture and fill the keys, body and background with your own palette. Try a different scheme when you want to give the next piano another look.

pages.title: Alphabet Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Practice letter recognition while finding pairs in Alphabet Memory. Turn over tiles, remember the alphabet symbols and match two identical ones. Choose easy, normal or hard mode to change how demanding the board is.

pages.title: Shot Trigger
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Time a gunman's shots in Shot Trigger to eliminate enemies while rescuing civilians. Watch the angle of the weapon as the character moves through the scene. Fire when the target lines up and continue until the route is clear.

pages.title: Hop Hop Dunk
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Move a hoop to catch falling basketballs in Hop Hop Dunk. Line the rim up with each ball and try to make a clean swish. Keep the sequence going to build a longer scoring chain.

pages.title: Santa Gift Shooter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fire sweets at presents in Santa Gift Shooter. Each shot costs money, so clear all the gifts before your budget runs out. Aim for bonus objects when you need more funds or a stronger shot.

pages.title: Christmas Story Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild six festive illustrations in Christmas Story Puzzle. Choose a board with sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four or one hundred pieces and fit the image together. Use the colorful holiday details to locate each piece.

pages.title: FZ Rabid Rabbit
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Gather carrots on an obstacle course in FZ Rabid Rabbit. Jump the hazards along the route and collect bonuses when you can reach them safely. Keep going to see how your carrot total compares with earlier runs.

pages.title: Spin Basketball
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rotate the setup to guide a ball into the hoop in Spin Basketball. Collect coins on the way and keep the ball away from spikes. Work out a route that reaches the basket to finish each stage.

pages.title: Kids Go Shopping Supermarket
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Explore virtual grocery shopping in Kids Go Shopping Supermarket. Follow the activities around the store and handle the items needed for each task. See how the shopping trip progresses as you visit different parts of the supermarket.

pages.title: Dingo the Dragon
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Guide a surviving baby dragon across its homeland in Dingo the Dragon. Tap to keep Dingo flying and steer past the dangers ahead. Continue the journey toward Biggie, the evil dragon who took over the land.

pages.title: EG Jumping
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Hold to compress a bird and release it into a leap in EG Jumping. Judge the gap to the next platform before choosing how much power to build. Collect coins to unlock more characters as you continue upward.

pages.title: Dino Squad Adventure 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Work through platforming levels with a dinosaur team in Dino Squad Adventure 2. Switch to the new character when its abilities help with an obstacle. Fight hostile dinosaurs and coordinate the squad to reach each stage's end.

pages.title: Crazy Shoot Factory
pages.creator: Hack TheREALITY
pages.description: Take on opponents in Crazy Shoot Factory. Explore the different maps and modes, changing your approach to the terrain around each fight. Find a useful firing position and react when enemies close in from another direction.

pages.title: HighSchool Cheerleader Dressup
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Create an outfit for a member of the school squad in HighSchool Cheerleader Dressup. Choose clothes and accessories that fit the cheerleading look you want. Compare combinations before completing the character's style.

pages.title: Tower Defense Alien War
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Protect a castle from invaders in Tower Defense Alien War. Fire upgraded guns and guided missiles at the alien troops, collecting gold from defeated enemies. Spend the rewards to strengthen the defense before the next stage.

pages.title: Stickman Punch
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stop approaching fighters from either side in Stickman Punch. Wait until a white stick figure enters range, then strike toward it to land the hit. Keep watching both directions as the waves try to catch you mistiming a punch.

pages.title: Couples Love Album
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Style a pair for a photo in Couples Love Album. Change their clothes, hairstyles and setting, then decorate the result with text, frames or effects. Build a finished picture that captures the look you chose for the couple.

pages.title: Basketball Master
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Tap a ball toward the basket in Basketball Master. Score before the timer expires, collect coins and use them to unlock more balls and locations. Try both modes as you work on timing the next shot.

pages.title: Mermaid Princess New Makeup
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose a new beauty look in Mermaid Princess New Makeup. Apply shades to the mermaid's face and compare how the colors work together. Finish the makeup by coordinating the details around her eyes, cheeks and lips.

pages.title: Spiky Circle
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Rotate the enclosure around a trapped face in Spiky Circle. Keep the spikes out of its way while adjusting to the character's movement. Use a controlled turn to leave another safe space before the next collision.

pages.title: Shooting at Buddies
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Aim at fruit balanced on a friend's head in Shooting at Buddies. Judge the shot carefully enough to hit the target without striking the person below it. Adjust the angle as the distance or position changes.

pages.title: Cartoon Cars Hidden Star
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Search illustrated vehicles for five stars in Cartoon Cars Hidden Star. Check the bodywork and the small background details to find the concealed shapes. Complete the picture to open the next, with no timer rushing the search.

pages.title: Mushroom Fall
pages.creator: TopSoft UG
pages.description: Guide a mushroom down through platforms in Mushroom Fall. Move toward openings and keep descending instead of getting trapped on an upper ledge. Watch the layout below as you try to travel deeper.

pages.title: Princesses Summer Vacation Trend
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose swimwear for a group visiting Hawaii in Princesses Summer Vacation Trend. Browse the wardrobe and coordinate each princess's poolside look. Finish the outfits before they begin their first day relaxing by the water.

pages.title: Sir Jump
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Jump through elevated platforms in Sir Jump. Watch the obstacles ahead and choose when to send the character into the air. Keep landing on the route as you head through the mountain course.

pages.title: Christmas Face Painting
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Paint festive patterns for three princesses in Christmas Face Painting. Choose a design for each face and add accessories that work with the colors. Give the group three different looks for their themed party.
